stem: A test randomises users but reports click-through per page view, and the analyst tests it as if every page view were independent. What is the problem?

options.text: None: users were randomised, so their page views count as independent
Views from one user are correlated, so the test is too confident
The test is too cautious, so it tends to miss effects that are real
Click-through cannot be computed per page view in a user-level test
